steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const w=Field.world();const kit=w&&w.view&&w.view.kit;const ids=(kit&&kit.doors||[]).map(d=>d.id);const want=['puddlewick_chapel','puddlewick_inn','hollybank','puddlewick_shop'];let opened=null;for(const id of want){if(kit&&kit.setDoor&&kit.setDoor(id,1)){opened=id;break;}}if(!opened&&ids[0]){kit.setDoor(ids[0],1);opened=ids[0];}const d=kit&&kit.doorAt&&kit.doorAt(opened);if(d&&d.front)__DQ.walkTo(d.front.x,d.front.z);else if(d)__DQ.walkTo(d.x+(d.nx||0)*2.0,d.z+(d.nz||0)*2.0);await sleep(1400);for(let i=0;i<120;i++){__DQ.advance(16.6667);if(i%8===0&&kit&&kit.doorsUpdate)kit.doorsUpdate(0.016, {x:__DQ.test&&0});}const amt=d&&d.amount;window.__DOOR={opened,ids:ids.slice(0,10),amount:amt,front:d&&d.front};return JSON.stringify(window.__DOOR);})()
